subject: Escalation: Aaron Lee — leveling discrepancy and offer timing
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Feb 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate Aaron Lee — split feedback and offer timing

Hi Laura / Mina,

Quick context: Aaron Lee (applied for Senior Infra Engineer — GenAI infra team) finished loop last week. Interview feedback split: 2 interviewers recommended L3 (strong individual contributor), 2 recommended L4 (broader system design + cross-team impact). I ran calibration with the panel; there's a real difference on how we weight ownership signals from the system design exercise.

Recruiting has a pending verbal offer we can extend as early as Thu 2/20 if we get leveling + comp sign-off. Aaron has one competing verbal offer and indicated he needs a decision by EOD Friday (2/21). Candidate expectation: L4 with ~20% above our mid L3 band.

Attachments: AaronLee_Resume.pdf, InterviewNotes_AaronLee.pdf.

Ask: Laura — do you want us to move forward at L3 (standard comp) or escalate for L4 justification/approval? Mina — if L4 is the ask, what approvers are required and ETA on decision?

Thanks,
Priyom
Recruiter | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Feb 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate Aaron Lee — split feedback and offer timing

Mina / Priyom —

I’m escalating for a quick leveling calibration. My read: Aaron is a L4. Key signals: led the design for dataflow partitioning in his last role that reduced end-to-end latency by 40%, repeatedly surfaced tradeoffs across infra and model teams, and proposed cross-team rollout plans (signals of scope & influence). The interview that favored L3 focused narrowly on API-level implementation details; I don’t think that reflects his system-level impact.

I’m attaching my written rationale and a short bulleted summary from the on-site: InterviewNotes_AaronLee.pdf (see page 2). Proposed comp if we approve L4: base $190k, target equity 0.08%, sign-on $15k. If we go L3, he will likely decline given his competing offer.

We need an expedited decision — Aaron’s timeline is tight. If Mina confirms L4 approval path, I want the offer extended on Thu (2/20) contingent on final HR sign-off.

-L
Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, GenAI Infra
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Feb 2025 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate Aaron Lee — split feedback and offer timing

Thanks Laura — and thanks for the clear rationale. A few items before I can sign off: 

1) Approvals needed for L4 outside standard band: VP of Eng (Tara Singh) + Compensation committee (runs twice weekly). We can route an expedited packet but need: (a) hiring manager rationale (you provided — good), (b) interview scorecards consolidated (Priyom pls attach), and (c) target total comp and band mapping.

2) Equity budget: L4 equity at 0.08% is above our typical for the role; I need to know if you can flex internal hires or if this is exceptional.

3) Timing: If you can confirm total cash + target equity by EOD today (Wed 2/19), I will escalate to Tara and request a compensation committee exception for Thu morning. If the committee approves, we should be able to get verbal offer out Thu and formal DocuSign by Fri.

Cc’ing Stephanie since Compensation team coordination may require her assistance with the packet.

Mina Haddad
HR Business Partner — Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@gmail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Feb 2025 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps and timeline

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again — quick update from my side: I do have another verbal offer that is slightly ahead on base and total comp; they asked for a decision by Friday 2/21 EOD. I’m very excited about Redwood and the team, but leveling is important to me for role scope and future trajectory. I’d accept L4 if the responsibilities and compensation reflect that level.

If necessary, I’m open to a conversation about initial title vs accelerated leveling review at 6 months, but I’d prefer clarity now on whether the role will be treated as L4.

Best,
Aaron
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Feb 2025 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate Aaron Lee — split feedback and offer timing

Mina — per our sync, I’m formally requesting an exception to approve Aaron at L4. Summary packet below:

- Rationale: demonstrated cross-team impact, led infra performance program with measurable outcomes, strong mentoring and cross-functional influence.
- Proposed cash: base $190,000; target bonus 12% (onsite expectations reflected); sign-on $15,000.
- Proposed equity: 0.08% (one-time grant at hire).
- Timeline: candidate deadline EOD 2/21; need verbal offer by EOD today if committee approves.

Please escalate to Tara and Compensation committee now; Priyom, standby to extend verbal offer. If committee needs a fallback, I recommend an interim approach: extend L3 base + accelerated leveling review at 6 months with a guaranteed compensation adjustment to L4 mid-band on successful review (but prefer full L4).

Thanks — pushing for expedited approval.

Laura
-- End of thread --
